# CloudBee Robotics

The self-improving OS for robots.

CloudBee Robotics is building a self-improving operating system for robots,
powered by scalable synthetic contact-rich data. Describe the task. Deploy the
capability. Start with a focused industrial pilot and review the results together.

Domain: https://cloudbeerobotics.de
Location: Aachen, Germany
Contact: mayur.waghchoure@cloudbeerobotics.de

## What we are building

- Synthetic contact-rich data for industrial manipulation: grasping, handling,
  placing and assembly, with task and object variation.
- Robot skills developed around the task, robot and end effector involved.
- A self-improving OS designed around operation, assessment and refinement,
  with a growing set of useful robot capabilities as the goal.
- Future self-serve access is in development; visitors can join the waitlist.

## Demonstrations and current work

Three featured videos show simulation demonstrations: contact and object
interaction, humanoid walking and object handling. They illustrate development
work. The team also works with real robot arms in its Aachen hardware lab.
Industrial pilots agree a specific test setting and success criteria.
Demonstrations: https://cloudbeerobotics.de/#see-it-work
Data offering: https://cloudbeerobotics.de/#contact-rich
Engineering focus: https://cloudbeerobotics.de/research

## For customers

- Explore automation opportunities for your industrial tasks.
- Work directly with our robotics team on a pilot.
- Agree success criteria and next steps for your application.
- Contact us at https://cloudbeerobotics.de/contact?interest=Pilot%20Program

## Robots and sectors

Robot arms, humanoids and dexterous hands.
Industrial manufacturing, automotive, electronics, battery technology and logistics.

## Company

RWTH Aachen spin-off, supported by EXIST and WestAI, with a hardware lab at
the Collective Incubator in Aachen.

Team: https://cloudbeerobotics.de/team
Company updates: https://cloudbeerobotics.de/blog
Investors: https://cloudbeerobotics.de/investors

## Careers

Engineering roles and three external master's thesis opportunities in Aachen.
Thesis applications close 30 October 2026. University registration is planned
for November 2026, with the thesis period from 1 December 2026 to 31 May 2027.
Careers: https://cloudbeerobotics.de/careers

This site publishes company information and customer benefits. Proprietary
